In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms.
